tenderSchedule.description: Replacement of old VHF sets by new digital VHF sets
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer CPS Office RTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
A Memorandum on the bidder firms letterhead as per enclosed format.
Other documents: Income tax PAN.Independent PF code registration.GST registration certificate.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that I have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.
Supplier should hold valid DPL issued from any WMS offices in India, to take over license activity and get operating license for new sets on behalf of KPCL-EECPS-RTPS.
Supplier should have sales and service center set up in Bangalore/KARNATKA to cater immediate pre and post warranty services for supplied equipments within the intimation of 24hours.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall have carried out similar work of supply and commissioning of VHF set/ base station/repeater station and as proof of the above, a copy of work order cum work done certificate of worth of Rs 4.05 lakhs executed in single work order/multiple work order in any one of the preceding Five years shall be furnished. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25& 2025-26) (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work order,PO and completion certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be an OEM/OES/dealer/supplier for Motorola/Kenwood VHF set/professional and commercial radio set. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of the same.

The bidder shall have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 9.6 Lakhs in any two of preceding five years and the bidder shall furnish turn over statement or profit & loss statement duly certified by chartered Accountant. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25& 2025-26) (Turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2025-26).

itemList.description: Supply of Motorola make VHF 136-174MHz, 5Watts RF Output, Analog/Digital Handheld walky-talky set, model: Kenwood NX-1200, supplied with following standard accessories. 2450mAh Li-Ion rechargeable battery pack, Belt clip, Helical Antenna, Single unit rapid battery charger and adopter

Supply of Motorola make VHF 136-174MHz, 25Watts RF Output, Analog/Digital Handheld Base/Mobile set, model: Kenwood NX3720HG, supplied with following standard accessories. DC Power cable 3meter, DTMF Microphone, Mounting kit, BNC male to UHF Female connector, User manual Following accessories required to make Base Station operational.
13.5V/15Amps AC-DC Power Supply Unit cum Battery Charger for Base Station. RG213 RF Coaxial cable of 30mtrs with UHF male connector
Supply of VHF Duplexer filter with connecting cables for Kenwood Repeater
Liasioning/Service charges towards condemnation of old sets and getting replacement letter from WPC New Delhi for new sets on existing license and license approval from WPC for new base station

Installation, Commissioning, Training Charges ( Required hardware materials for installation of Base Station and Repeater
